subject: Convert Probit coefficient to ORs with correct P vlaues.

messages.author: f87e6c4f2cd29251
messages.subject: Convert Probit coefficient to ORs with correct P vlaues.
parts:
I am running a sequential mediation analysis with binary outocome using (WLSMV/Theta). To obtain ORs from probit, i followed this approach: 

model <- ’

ciguse ˜ c*intervention +

  b*intention

intention ˜ a*intervention

# label threshold for ciguse

ciguse | b0*t1

probit11 := (-b0+c+b*a)/sqrt(bˆ2+1)

probit10 := (-b0+c )/sqrt(bˆ2+1)

probit00 := (-b0 )/sqrt(bˆ2+1)

indirect := pnorm(probit11) - pnorm(probit10)

direct := pnorm(probit10) - pnorm(probit00)

OR.indirect := (pnorm(probit11)/(1-pnorm(probit11)))/ (pnorm(probit10)/(1-pnorm(probit10)))

OR.direct := (pnorm(probit10)/(1-pnorm(probit10)))/ (pnorm(probit00)/(1-pnorm(probit00)))

=> 

I noticed the p-values did not match the CIs when obtained with the code. I thought it might be because lavaan was testing based on an the null hypothesis that the coefficient equals zero (H₀: β = 0), which might not hold for OR since the null is OR = 1.
When I changed from calculating OR to log odds, the results of pvalue were matching the CI of ORs. 
I got the same results when I created hypothesis tests that subtract 1 from each odds ratio, effectively testing H₀: OR - 1 = 0, which is mathematically equivalent to testing H₀: OR = 1. 
I am not sure, why i had to go over this loop, and why lavaan did not automatically set the appropriate null. 
Or if i am missing something.
